provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Horsham, Chapter 230 Zoning (Horsham Township Zoning Ordinance of 1995, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 header on 2026-11-13: legislation through 07-08-2026. Recent zoning amendments seen in the text: Ord. No. 2024-02 (R-1, 11-13-2024), Ord. No. 2025-01 (230-16, 2-12-2025), Ord. No. 2025-05 (R-4, 11-12-2025). New Laws lists only Ord. No. 2026-03 (Chapter 5, not zoning).
checks: Chapter 230 has no accessory dwelling text. The residential districts R-1 to R-4 permit one principal use, a single-family detached dwelling, and customary accessory uses (230-51 to 230-63)
Uses accessory to a dwelling are a private garage, a pool, greenhouses and storage buildings, stables and home occupations, and not 'a hotel, boarding home or any other similar use' (230-15C)

Conversion: the Zoning Hearing Board may allow, by special exception, the conversion of a single-family dwelling into a dwelling for more families. A petition signed by owners of 60% or more of the frontage on the same street within 500 ft is required. Each unit at least 750 sq ft. Lot area per family at least 75% of the district requirement. No exterior change (230-17)
R-5: two-family dwellings (duplexes) may be permitted where all dimensional rules are met. 10,000 sq ft lot with public sewer and water (230-66B, 230-67)
Historic Resource Overlay: a Class I historic resource may be converted into apartments by special exception, at least 800 sq ft each (230-201)

Accessory buildings: 14 ft in side or rear yards, 21.5 ft inside the building envelope. In a side yard only behind the rear line of the house and 7 ft from side and rear lines. Not in the minimum front yard. R-4: one story and 14 ft, rear yard only (230-16, 230-64F)
Total floor area of accessory buildings: on lots under two acres at most 50% of the house footprint, on two acres or more at most the footprint (230-16F)
Parking: three spaces per single-family dwelling, not counting garage spaces (230-32A(1))
Nonconforming lot: a single-family dwelling may be built on a lot of at least 80% of the district area (230-11)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Horsham Township (horsham.org). Read on eCode360 in a browser, the chapter print view searched in the page and section print views. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, elder cottage, ECHO, caretaker, guest house, carriage house, tenant house, second dwelling, tiny house, family suite, accessory residential, short-term, kitchen. 'Carriage house' appears only as a single-family attached dwelling type. No unlisted-use section found (searched 'not specifically', 'not provided for', 'uses not listed'). Districts R-6, R-7, MR-1, MR-2, MHD, RGCC and the commercial districts were not read row by row.

term.note: No ADU term. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, elder cottage, ECHO, caretaker, guest house, carriage house, tenant house, second dwelling, tiny house, family suite, accessory residential.

status.note: No ADU text. A second unit is not a listed accessory use of a dwelling (230-15C), and the residential districts allow 'one principal use' (230-51).

path.note: A second unit on a single-family lot is not permitted. A use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board. Conversion of the house under 230-17 is a separate special exception path, see alternatives.

fallback_path.note: No unlisted-use special exception in Chapter 230. Under 230-233A the Zoning Hearing Board may decide 'whether questionable uses are permitted by virtue of being "similar to" or "customarily incidental to" permitted uses'. That is an interpretation, not a special exception. 230-15C(5) weighs against a second dwelling as a use accessory to a dwelling.

value.name: Conversion of a single-family dwelling
value.conditions: Petition signed by owners of 60% or more of the frontage on the same street within 500 ft. Each unit at least 750 sq ft. Lot area per family at least 75% of the district requirement. District yards and building area met. No exterior change except for safety. Parking met. Only for 'a dwelling with relatively little economic usefulness as a conforming use'.
value.note: Two units at 75% of the district lot each, 1.5 times the district lot.

value.name: Two-family dwelling (duplex)
value.conditions: Permitted 'if all dimensional requirements, including, but not limited to, minimum lot widths and yard requirements can be maintained and adequate provision is made for off-street parking'. Public sewer and water.
value.note: 230-67A sets 10,000 sq ft for every principal building. Whether a duplex needs more is not stated.

value.name: Conversion apartments in a Class I historic resource
value.conditions: A residential structure designated a Class I historic resource in the Historic Resource Overlay. Each unit at least 800 sq ft, own bathroom and kitchen. Exterior work per the Historical Advisory Commission. Parking per 230-32.

historic_bypass.note: The historic overlay allows conversion apartments in a Class I resource by special exception. Not an ADU path. See alternatives.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory building rule, not an ADU rule. 'The maximum permitted height of buildings or structures when located within required side or rear yards shall be 14 feet.'

value.where: entirely within the required building envelope
value.note: '21 feet six inches for accessory buildings and structures located entirely within the required building envelope'.

setback_side_ft.note: Accessory building rule. 'not be less than seven feet each from the side and rear lot line'.

setback_front_ft.note: 'Accessory buildings or structures are not permitted within the minimum front yard'. The district front yard applies.

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code allows no ADU.

short_term_rental_banned.note: No short-term rental rule found in Chapter 230.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. 'Single-family detached dwellings: three spaces per unit, not including garage spaces.'

setback_side_ft.note: Two side yards, 40 ft together, neither under 20 ft.

min_lot_sqft.note: With public water and sewers. Ord. No. 2025-05.

setback_side_ft.note: With public water and sewer: 25 ft together, neither under 10 ft.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Accessory structures one story and at most 14 ft, rear yard only, 7 ft from side and rear lines.
